concurrency_and_state: Service.cs:9,110-119,813-815,1739-1748,1766-1775,1793-1802,1820-1829,2279-2288,2444-2453,2707-2717,2967-2977: Service singleton mutates its shared instance field `this.session = Session_ME2.gI()` before `sendMessage()` and restores `Session_ME.gI()` afterwards (not in `finally`), racing with concurrent callers and permanently sticking to Session_ME2 if an exception occurs.

Session_ME.cs:241-295 & Session_ME2.cs:227-279: Both session classes store connection state, streams, threads, XOR key, and byte counters in `static` fields while keeping host/port/timeWaitConnect as instance fields, making multi-instance impossible and risking cross-state contamination.

Session_ME2.cs:13-61,279,288,459-500: Session_ME2 accesses `Sender.sendingMessage` (`List<Message>`) and `recieveMsg` (`MyVector`) without any lock across main thread (`AddMessage`, `clearSendingMessage`, `update`) and background `sendThread`/`collectorThread` (`Sender.run`, `onRecieveMsg`).

Session_ME.cs:375-384: `doConnect` starts `collectorThread` at line 380 before calling `doSendMessage(-27)` and setting `key = null` at line 384, creating a startup race if the `-27` key response arrives before line 384 executes.

Session_ME.cs:538-599 & Session_ME2.cs:507-542: `cleanNetwork` closes socket/streams without locking against `Sender`/`MessageCollector`, uses `Thread.Abort()` on main thread in `Session_ME`, and neither class clears `recieveMsg` or `sendingMessage` on disconnect/reconnect.
Session_ME.cs:352 & Session_ME2.cs:332: `NetworkInit` sets `connected = true` before `doConnect` succeeds, exposing a partially initialized session to `isConnected()` and worker threads.
cross_module_questions: Does the Java Netty server handle opcode 18 (used by both `Service.gotoPlayer` and `Service.requestPlayerInfo`), opcode 24 (used by both `Service.sendOptHat` and `Service.sendCT_ready`), and opcode -45 (`skill_not_focus` vs `new_skill_not_focus`) without payload ambiguity?

Does `Session_ME2.isMainSession = true` (Session_ME2.cs:237) get overwritten by `GameCanvas.connect2()` before `connect()`, or does a `Session_ME2` failure/disconnect trigger main-session disconnect dialogs and `connect2()` recursion in `getKey`?

Does the server expect little-endian `ushort` or big-endian 2-byte length for unencrypted messages (`getKeyComplete == false`), since `Session_ME.doSendMessage` writes `(ushort)num` (LE) when `!getKeyComplete` vs BE `(num>>8),(num&0xFF)` when `getKeyComplete`?

How does the Java server parse `Service.charMove` (cmd -7) conditional `cy` (3-byte vs 5-byte packet), `Service.buyItem` (cmd 6) conditional `quantity` (`if (quantity > 1)`), and `Service.useItem` (cmd -43) where `index == -1` triggers `writeShort(template)` (colliding with slot 255)?

Are `Service.sendOptHat(1)` (`Res.TakeSnapShot()`), `Service.sendServerData`, `Service.charMove` (client-computed `cx/cy` and MP deduction), and `Service.new_skill_not_focus` validated server-side against spoofing or oversized payloads?

findings.impact: TCP stream framing permanently desyncs on partial socket reads, corrupting the XOR keystream and dropping/garbling all subsequent packets; `readMessage2` can also NRE if called before key exchange or allocate huge buffers.
findings.root_cause: `dis.ReadBytes(num)` is assumed to always return `num` bytes (no read-loop until `num` bytes received), and `readMessage2` unconditionally calls `readKey()` without checking `getKeyComplete` or validating `num4` upper bounds.
findings.title: Partial TCP Read & Unchecked readMessage2 Framing Desync

findings.impact: Opcode `66` (`getImgByName`) received over `Session_ME2` is parsed with a 2-byte length instead of 3-byte `readMessage2`, corrupting the TCP stream.
findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2.MessageCollector.readMessage()` checks `b == -32 || b == -66 || b == 11 || b == -67 || b == -74 || b == -87` and omits `|| b == 66` present in `Session_ME.cs:202`.
findings.title: Missing Extended-Length Opcode 66 in Session_ME2.readMessage

findings.impact: Concurrent `AddMessage`/`RemoveAt`/`Clear` on `List<Message>` and `addElement`/`removeElementAt` on `MyVector` across threads can corrupt collections, drop packets, or throw `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`.
findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2` accesses `Sender.sendingMessage` and `recieveMsg` from main, sender, and collector threads without synchronization locks (unlike `Session_ME.cs`).
findings.title: Unsynchronized Send/Receive Queues Across Threads in Session_ME2

findings.impact: Gameplay/trade/combat packets can be routed to the secondary asset session (`Session_ME2`), or `Service.session` can remain permanently stuck on `Session_ME2` if `sendMessage` throws.
findings.root_cause: Ten asset/update methods temporarily overwrite the shared `Service.session` field with `Session_ME2.gI()` before `sendMessage()` and reset it outside `finally`.
findings.title: Shared Service.session Field Mutation Race With Session_ME2

findings.impact: Sending any message with non-null payload before `getKeyComplete` silently drops all payload bytes on the wire while writing an unencrypted little-endian `ushort` length, corrupting framing.
findings.root_cause: In `doSendMessage`, the `if (getKeyComplete)` loop writing `data` bytes has no `else` branch for `!getKeyComplete`, and unencrypted length uses `dos.Write((ushort)num)` (little-endian) vs big-endian when encrypted.
findings.title: Missing Unencrypted Payload Write & Endianness Mismatch in doSendMessage

findings.impact: Session XOR keystream breaks with `OverflowException` or `IndexOutOfRangeException` if server sends a key of length >= 128 bytes.
findings.root_cause: Key length is read via `readSByte()`, and `curR`/`curW` are `sbyte` indices that wrap negative at 128 (`curR = (sbyte)(num + 1)`).
findings.title: Signed sbyte Overflow in XOR Key Length and curR/curW Indices

findings.impact: `Session_ME2` defaults to `isMainSession = true`, which can trigger main-session disconnect/fail handlers and infinite `GameCanvas.connect2()` recursion on secondary socket events.
findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2` was copy-pasted from `Session_ME` with `public static bool isMainSession = true;`.
findings.title: Session_ME2 Defaults isMainSession to true

findings.impact: `doConnect` starts `collectorThread` before `key = null`, allowing a fast `-27` key response to be wiped; `cleanNetwork` can race with streams, abort threads unsafely, and retain stale queued messages across reconnects.
findings.root_cause: Thread startup and teardown lack synchronization, `key = null` is placed after thread start, and `recieveMsg`/`sendingMessage` are not cleared in `cleanNetwork`.
findings.title: Unsynchronized Session Startup/Teardown and Stale Queues on Reconnect

findings.impact: Opcode collisions and `sbyte` truncation risk misrouted handlers or silent slot/ID corruption when inventory/map/template indices exceed 127.
findings.root_cause: `gotoPlayer` and `requestPlayerInfo` share cmd `18`; `sendOptHat` and `sendCT_ready` share cmd `24`; `skill_not_focus` and `new_skill_not_focus` share cmd `-45`; numerous item/UI indices and IDs are written via `writeByte()`, and `useItem` uses `-1` sentinel for `template`.
findings.title: Overloaded Opcodes (18, 24, -45) and Signed Byte Slot/ID Truncation in Service.cs

findings.impact: Client controls and sends its own position, flying MP deduction, target coords, and arbitrary byte blobs (`sendOptHat`, `sendServerData`), enabling speed/teleport/skill-range exploits if server trusts them.
findings.root_cause: `charMove` computes MP locally and sends `cx`/`cy`, `new_skill_not_focus` sends self and target coords, and `sendOptHat(1)`/`sendServerData` upload unvalidated client byte arrays.
findings.title: Client-Trusted Coordinates, Local MP Deduction, and Raw Byte Uploads

findings.impact: God class (`Service.cs` 3285 lines) and copy-pasted `Session_ME`/`Session_ME2` cause feature drift, unclosed `/info` file handles, swallowed exceptions, and `NullReferenceException` in `finally` blocks (`message.cleanup()`).
findings.root_cause: Duplicated `Session_ME`/`Session_ME2` and `setClientType`/`setClientType2`/`magicTree`/`getMagicTree`; unguarded `message.cleanup()` in `finally`; missing `cleanup()` and null guard in `sendPlayerAttack`; unclosed `MyStream.readFile("/info")`; `dos.Flush()` inside `catch` in `Session_ME.doSendMessage:452`.
findings.title: Service God Class, Copy-Paste Session Drift, and Unguarded Cleanup/Stream Leaks

findings.impact: Secondary asset downloads on `Session_ME2` are artificially capped at <=200 msgs/sec and trigger extra GC pressure; `charMove` allocates `new Message(-7)` while moving.
findings.root_cause: `Session_ME2.MessageCollector.run()` sleeps 5ms after every received packet; `readMessage`/`readMessage2` allocate a throwaway `new sbyte[num]` before `ArrayCast.cast(src)`; `Session_ME.Sender.doSendMessage` never calls `m.cleanup()`.
findings.title: Per-Packet Thread.Sleep(5) Bottleneck and Unnecessary Message/Buffer Allocations

key_classes.name: Game1.Service
key_classes.responsibility: Singleton outbound packet builder/dispatcher (~130+ methods) encoding all client-to-server commands onto Session_ME or Session_ME2.

key_classes.name: Game1.Session_ME
key_classes.responsibility: Primary TCP socket session managing connection lifecycle, XOR stream cipher, threaded send/receive loops, and main-thread message queue dispatch.

key_classes.name: Game1.Session_ME2
key_classes.responsibility: Secondary TCP socket session (copy-pasted from Session_ME) used by Service.cs for asset/template downloads (icons, backgrounds, resources, map/skill/item updates).

module_summary: Batch covers the Unity C# client's outbound packet factory (`Service.cs`, 3285 lines) and both TCP transport implementations (`Session_ME.cs`, 637 lines; `Session_ME2.cs`, 575 lines). `Service` is a monolithic singleton constructing binary `Message` payloads for gameplay, UI, trade, combine, clan, consignment, and asset downloads, temporarily switching its `session` field to `Session_ME2` for resource packets. `Session_ME` and `Session_ME2` implement TCP framing, XOR keystream encryption, and background send/receive threads, with `Session_ME2` containing older unsynchronized queue/list code, a missing extended-length opcode (`66`), and `isMainSession = true`.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Empty handshake request sent immediately on TCP connect before XOR key exchange.
keyLen (sbyte), key bytes (XOR-chained), IP2 (UTF), PORT2 (int), isConnect2 (byte).
3-byte extended length header (`readMessage2`) for large asset/data payloads (`66` omitted in Session_ME2).
messageNotLogin: sub 0 login(user,pass,version,type); sub 1 register(user,pass,[userAo,"a"]); sub 2 setClientType/2(type,zoom,false,w,h,qwerty,touch,platform|ver,/info bytes).

messageNotMap: selectChar(1), createChar(2), updateMap/Skill/Item(6-8), requestSkill/Map/Npc(9,10,12), clientOk(13), card(16), clearTask(17), changeName(18), convertUpgrade(33), clanDun(34), accProtect(37-39,41), split(40).
messageSubCommand: upPotential(16), upSkill(17), boxSort(19), boxCoinOut(21), requestItem(22), saveRms(60), loadRMS(61), playerMenu(63,64), upPotentialPet(-99).
charMove: isFly(byte 0/1), cx(short), optional cy(short if dy != 0).
Combine (-81,13,14) and Trade (-86,36,37,38,39,50) item indexUI/coin/action packets.
Shop buy/sale(6,7), pick/throw(-20,-18), useItem(-43), consignment kigui(-100).
Overloaded opcodes: 18 (gotoPlayer vs requestPlayerInfo), 24 (sendOptHat vs sendCT_ready), -45 (skill_not_focus vs new_skill_not_focus).
Asset/template requests routed via Session_ME2 when connected: updateData(-87), icon(-67), bg(-32), resource(-74), imageSource(-111), imgByName(66), mod(11), eff(-66).
Remaining gameplay, clan, social, chat, radar, captcha, pet, flag, crackball, and ping/sync opcodes.
